editorial.blurb: New Zaiqa brings authentic Hyderabadi flavors to life with bold, generously portioned dishes that keep regulars coming back—just call ahead for Saturday specials.
editorial.insiderTip: Call ahead to confirm availability of Chicken 65 (usually Saturdays only) and check which meat options are in stock that day, as their menu shifts. Order for takeout if you want to avoid the cramped dine-in setup.
